title: Four-box story strip
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y3 lesson 14 (Pupil PDF worksheet: four-box story strip)
intro: Lesson 14: The community learns to call to prayer. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: A problem to solve
points: People came to the masjid at different times
They met to decide what to do

cards: A man calling with his voice
blocks.title: Sort into: Idea they talked about / What was chosen
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Idea they talked about, What was chosen.
blocks.answer: Idea they talked about: Ringing a bell; Blowing a horn; Lighting a fire. What was chosen: A man calling with his voice

panels.title: Bilal calls the adhan
points: The Prophet ﷺ told Bilal to call

keywords.def: the person who calls the adhan
people who live, pray and work together

questions.q: Why did the Muslims need a call to prayer?
questions.a: So everyone knew when to come and pray together

questions.q: The person who calls the adhan is the ...
Draw a four-box story strip: the problem, the meeting, the choice, Bilal's call. Add a caption to each.
questions.a: Problem: people did not know the time. Meeting: ideas shared. Choice: a voice. Bilal called the adhan.

questions.q: Extend: what should we do when we hear the adhan?
questions.a: Stop, listen, repeat the words and get ready to pray.

questions.q: Stretch: why is a human voice a good way to call to prayer?
questions.a: It uses Allah's words of praise and calls people kindly.

questions.q: Who was the first person to call the adhan?
questions.a: A) Bilal. Bilal was told by the Prophet ﷺ to call; he became the first mu'adhdhin.

questions.q: Think again: how did Madinah know it was time to pray?
questions.a: Bilal called the adhan with his voice.
